title: Family in Town for Thanksgiving?
why: Seasonal: Houston hosts with out-of-town family over Thanksgiving weekend; gives them a non-couch plan.
hook_options: Family in town? Get them out of the house.
Day two of the visit needs a plan.
Show the cousins the Houston they didn't expect.
caption: Thanksgiving weekend, day two. Everyone is full and someone asks what there is to do in Houston. Take them out on Clear Lake for an afternoon. Bring the leftovers. #HoustonPartyBarge #ClearLake #HoustonThanksgiving #Kemah

slides.headline: Family in town? Get them out of the house.
slides.body: Four days of leftovers and football. Give them one afternoon on Clear Lake instead.

slides.headline: Day two of the visit hits different.
slides.body: Everyone is full, the couch is taken, and someone's asking what there is to do in Houston.

slides.headline: Show them the Houston they didn't expect.
slides.body: Open water, Kemah on the horizon, a bay breeze. Out-of-towners never see this part.

slides.headline: Ages 8 and up. Grandpa included.
slides.body: A roof for shade, a bathroom on board, no dress code. The cousin who hates boats will be fine.

slides.headline: Bring the leftovers. Seriously.
slides.body: It's BYO food and drinks. Turkey sliders and a cooler of cans make an elite boat menu. Just no glass.

slides.headline: Fall afternoons are the sweet spot.
slides.body: Cooler air, earlier sunsets, and nobody melting on the dock like it's July.

slides.headline: Sunset shows up early in November.
slides.body: Book a late afternoon slot and the sky does its thing before dinner.

slides.headline: Big family? Take the whole boat.
slides.body: Private charters fit up to 26. No strangers, and the playlist stays in the family.

slides.headline: Holiday weekends fill first.
slides.body: Fridays and weekend evenings from October through December go early. Lock the date before the flights land.

slides.headline: Give them a Houston story to take home.
slides.body: Public cruises or the whole boat at houstonpedalbarge.com. Send this to whoever is hosting.
